verses.restored: The feast of Unleavened Bread, called Passover, was drawing near.

familiar.text: Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh, which is called the Passover.

verses.restored: The chief priests and scribes were seeking how they might remove him, for they feared the people.

familiar.text: And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill him; for they feared the people.

verses.restored: The Adversary entered into Judas called Iscariot, who was of the number of the twelve.

familiar.text: Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot, being of the number of the twelve.

verses.restored: He went away and conferred with the chief priests and officers how he might hand him over to them.

familiar.text: And he went his way, and communed with the chief priests and captains, how he might betray him unto them.

familiar.text: And they were glad, and covenanted to give him money.

verses.restored: He consented and sought a good opportunity to hand him over apart from a crowd.

familiar.text: And he promised, and sought opportunity to betray him unto them in the absence of the multitude.

verses.restored: The day of Unleavened Bread came, on which the Passover had to be sacrificed.

familiar.text: Then came the day of unleavened bread, when the passover must be killed.

familiar.text: And he sent Peter and John, saying, Go and prepare us the passover, that we may eat.

familiar.text: And ye shall say unto the goodman of the house, The Master saith unto thee, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?

verses.restored: He will show you a large furnished upper room; prepare there.

familiar.text: And he shall shew you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.

verses.restored: They went and found just as he had said to them, and they prepared the Passover.

familiar.text: And they went, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.

verses.restored: When the hour came, he reclined, and the apostles with him.

familiar.text: And when the hour was come, he sat down, and the twelve apostles with him.

verses.restored: He said to them, With desire I desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer.

familiar.text: And he said unto them, With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer:

verses.restored: For I say to you, I will certainly not eat it until it is fulfilled in the reign of the Divine.

familiar.text: For I say unto you, I will not any more eat thereof, until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God.

familiar.text: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and said, Take this, and divide it among yourselves:

familiar.text: And he took bread, and gave thanks, and brake it, and gave unto them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.

verses.restored: They began to discuss among themselves who of them might be about to do this.

familiar.text: And they began to enquire among themselves, which of them it was that should do this thing.
